data.text: My family taught me that looking after this lake means looking after the village, too. With the emergency verified and a workable recovery plan, I commit to harvesting 15 tons this month and donating the $15,000, provided all four pledges are secured before we fish. I also commit to no more than 6 tons next month under the combined 30-ton recovery cap. Let’s have the proceeds paid directly to the clinic and share its receipt here. John, can you confirm your commitment?
